name: Zailai Dian Baihe Ba - More☆Love Yuri
original_name: 再来点百合吧 More☆Love Yuri
source:
Voice actress Lu Xi and writer Shu Yu continue their life together. After the incident, they became a fan-favored “official CP,” forced to act close at events. Sweet days flow on, small ripples appear, and their bond deepens—until the rejected Twin Souls ending unfolds in reality.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4249650/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
配音演员陆希和作家舒宇继续他们的生活。事件发生后，他们成为了粉丝喜爱的“官方CP”，被迫在活动中表现得亲密。甜蜜的日子继续流逝，小小的涟漪出现，他们的联系加深——直到被拒绝的双生灵魂结局在现实中展开。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4249650/]Steam[/url]]
